rows.details: Army Public School Sukna, Darjeeling, West Bengal
Term-based teachers with more than three years of term-based service and at least three ACRs

content_sections.heading: About APS Sukna
content_sections.text: Army Public School Sukna is a CBSE-affiliated school at PO Simulbari via Sukna, District Darjeeling, West Bengal. This circular, dated 23 November 2026 and signed by the Principal, Mrs Dola Sarkar Sinha, is addressed to teachers and staff on the Staff Regularization Board. Copies go to APS Bagrakote and APS Kalimpong.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Eligible term-based teachers must submit an application along with bio data by 28 November 2026. The documents listed below must be attested by the Principal of the concerned APS. The notice does not print a postal address, an email address for applications or a mode of submission. The Principal of each concerned school also hands over certain documents to the BOO of SRB (see Enclosures).

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: Term-based teachers who have completed more than three years of service as term-based are eligible for consideration for regularization through the SRB. They must also have earned a minimum of three ACRs in one or more than one cycle of employment. The notice does not print a separate educational qualification, experience rule or age limit for each post. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of each post.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Documents to be submitted by the teacher with the application, duly attested by the Principal: Education qualification – class X onwards. AWES OST score card. Awards earned by the teacher while working in school with respect to school related activity: AWWA/CBSE/NCTE, GOC-in-C Commendation Card, COAS Commendation Card, Award by MOE. Results (Cl Average) achieved by the teacher during the last 03 years, for Cl X and XII board exam results, along with Bd result. Students scoring above 95% marks in Board Exam (only last one year), along with Bd result. Documents the Principal of the concerned school hands over, duly attested, to the BOO of SRB for teachers who have applied: ACR of last three years. Valid complaint against the teacher leading to disciplinary action. Counselling letter issued to the teacher.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection is through the Staff Regularization Board, which is to be held shortly; the notice prints no date. Each candidate has to undergo teaching practice in a class on a topic given 24 hours prior. The BOO of SRB will assess the teaching practice. If a teacher is found fit for regular appointment but cannot be made regular because no vacancy is available or because of inter-se merit of candidates, he or she may be given another term-based tenure if the existing tenure expired on 31 Mar 2027. Employees not recommended for regularization or another term will be released with no further option of employment in APS.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in APS Sukna Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 3 regular vacancies: 1 TGT (Science), 1 TGT (Social Science) and 1 PRT (All).

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The last date is 28 November 2026. The notice says "latest by 28 Nov 2026" and does not say whether it is for receipt or dispatch.

faq.question: Q3. Who can apply for these posts?
faq.answer: Term-based teachers who have completed more than three years of service as term-based and earned a minimum of three ACRs in one or more than one cycle of employment.

faq.question: Q4. How do I apply?
faq.answer: Submit an application along with bio data by 28 November 2026, with the listed documents duly attested by the Principal of the concerned APS.

faq.question: Q5. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: Candidates are considered by the Staff Regularization Board and must undergo teaching practice in a class on a topic given 24 hours prior, assessed by the BOO of SRB.

faq.question: Q6. What documents are required?
faq.answer: Education qualification from class X onwards, AWES OST score card, awards earned in school, class average results for Cl X and XII of the last 03 years with Bd result, and results of students scoring above 95% in the last one year with Bd result.

faq.question: Q7. What happens if a teacher is found fit but no vacancy is available?
faq.answer: The teacher may be given another term-based tenure if the existing tenure expired on 31 Mar 2027. Teachers not recommended for regularization or another term will be released with no further option of employment in APS.

faq.question: Q8. Which documents does the Principal give to the SRB?
faq.answer: The Principal hands over the ACR of the last three years, any valid complaint leading to disciplinary action, and any counselling letter issued to the teacher, all duly attested.
